_readme: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — no code parses this file; every actual routing decision is made in code (adapters/echarts/validate.mjs SUPPORTED_VISUALS, option-builder.mjs, render.mjs explainSelection()). Three call sites point AI agents/humans at this file by name in error messages and MCP tool descriptions ('see ENGINE_ROUTING_POLICY.json') for the human-readable why, not to have it parsed. Labelled 2026-08-23 (P8-084) rather than wiring a real reader, per OG-39/OG-91's precedent: adding a second enforcer of a routing rule the code already enforces is the defect this engine exists to catch, not a fix for it.
rule: AI agents select and specify; approved engines render; project templates remain visual authority.
